test_cases.description: When all subtasks in the target group have empty refs, render_individual_scoped invokes traceability inference and returns a scoped result filtered to the inferred refs.
preconditions: A Spec is constructed with a TaskGroup id=3 containing subtasks with empty requirement_refs and test_spec_refs

Python: afspec package installed; Go: afspec package compiled

input.spec: Spec with group 3 subtasks having empty refs; traceability entries: [{task_id: '3.1', requirement_id: '02-REQ-1', test_spec_id: 'TS-02-1'}]

test_cases.expected: Returns a scoped dict/map containing only the requirement and test spec sections referenced by the inferred refs ('02-REQ-1' and 'TS-02-1'); does not contain sections for other requirements or test specs

assert '02-REQ-1' appears in result['requirements']
assert 'TS-02-1' appears in result['test_spec']
# Verify unrelated requirement not in result
assert '02-REQ-2' not in result.get('requirements', '')

property_tests.description: For any spec and target group, every ID returned by inference helpers exists in the spec's known ID sets — inference never produces phantom refs.
property_tests.for_any_strategy: Generate random Spec instances with varying traceability entries and subtask text containing a mix of valid spec IDs and random ID-like strings (e.g., 'XX-REQ-999'). Sample at least 50 combinations of spec and target_group values.
property_tests.invariant_check:
req_refs, ts_refs = _infer_refs_from_traceability(spec, tg) OR _infer_refs_from_subtask_text(spec, tg)
known_req_ids = collect_all_requirement_ids(spec)
known_ts_ids = collect_all_test_spec_ids(spec)
assert all(r in known_req_ids for r in req_refs)
assert all(t in known_ts_ids for t in ts_refs)

property_tests.description: For any spec and target group where inference or explicit refs yield non-empty collections, the scoped rendering output is a subset of the unscoped output.
property_tests.for_any_strategy: Generate random Spec instances with at least one requirement and one test spec entry. For each, construct a target group with subtasks referencing a subset of the spec's IDs. Sample at least 30 combinations.
property_tests.invariant_check:
scoped = render_individual_scoped(spec, target_group)
unscoped = render_individual(spec)
# Every key in scoped exists in unscoped
assert all(k in unscoped for k in scoped)
# Content of each scoped key is a substring of or equal to the unscoped content
assert all(scoped[k] in unscoped[k] or scoped[k] == unscoped[k] for k in scoped)

property_tests.description: For any spec and target group where both inference strategies return empty collections, the tasks section in the fallback output is always scoped to the target group and never contains tasks from other groups.
property_tests.for_any_strategy: Generate random Spec instances with 2–5 task groups, each with 1–3 subtasks having empty refs and no traceability or ID patterns. For each spec, pick a random target_group from the available group IDs. Sample at least 30 combinations.

property_tests.description: For any spec passed to validate/Validate, checkMissingSubtaskRefs emits exactly one warning per subtask with empty refs (excluding WIRING_VERIFICATION groups), never zero and never more than one per subtask.
property_tests.for_any_strategy: Generate random Spec instances with 1–5 task groups of mixed kinds (STANDARD, TESTS, CHECKPOINT, WIRING_VERIFICATION), each with 0–5 subtasks having randomly empty or non-empty refs. Sample at least 50 specs.
property_tests.invariant_check:
warnings = _check_missing_subtask_refs(spec)
affected_subtask_ids = [
    s.id for g in spec.tasks.task_groups
    if g.kind != WIRING_VERIFICATION
    for s in g.subtasks
    if not s.requirement_refs or not s.test_spec_refs
]
# Exactly one warning per affected subtask
assert len(warnings) == len(affected_subtask_ids)
warning_entity_ids = [w.entity_id for w in warnings]
assert sorted(warning_entity_ids) == sorted(affected_subtask_ids)

property_tests.description: For any subtask with any combination of empty requirement_refs and test_spec_refs, the warning message always matches the exact template with one of three valid field_names values.
property_tests.for_any_strategy: Enumerate all three combinations of empty refs: (req_empty=True, ts_empty=False), (req_empty=False, ts_empty=True), (req_empty=True, ts_empty=True). For each, generate 10 subtasks with random IDs and run checkMissingSubtaskRefs.
property_tests.invariant_check:
import re
MSG_PATTERN = re.compile(r'^Subtask .+ has empty (requirement_refs|test_spec_refs|requirement_refs and test_spec_refs) — scoped rendering will fall back to full spec dump$')
for warning in warnings:
    assert MSG_PATTERN.match(warning.message), f'Message does not match template: {warning.message}'

property_tests.description: For any spec and target group with empty explicit refs, text-based inference is never attempted when traceability-based inference returns non-empty collections for at least one ref type.
property_tests.for_any_strategy: Generate random Spec instances where traceability entries exist for the target group (ensuring non-empty traceability inference). Instrument _infer_refs_from_subtask_text with a call counter. Sample at least 20 specs.
property_tests.invariant_check:
text_inference_call_count = 0
original_fn = _infer_refs_from_subtask_text
def counting_fn(spec, tg):
    nonlocal text_inference_call_count
    text_inference_call_count += 1
    return original_fn(spec, tg)
patch(_infer_refs_from_subtask_text, counting_fn)
render_individual_scoped(spec, target_group)
assert text_inference_call_count == 0, 'Text inference must not be called when traceability inference succeeds'

property_tests.description: The regex patterns _REQ_ID_RE/_TS_ID_RE (Python) and reqIDRe/tsIDRe (Go) are compiled exactly once at module/package init time across any number of calls to render_individual_scoped/RenderIndividualScoped.
property_tests.for_any_strategy: Call render_individual_scoped N times (N sampled from [1, 10, 100, 1000]) in a single process with varying specs. After each batch, inspect the identity/address of the compiled regex objects.
property_tests.invariant_check:
import afspec.render as render_mod
pattern_id_before = id(render_mod._REQ_ID_RE)
for _ in range(N):
    render_individual_scoped(spec, target_group)
pattern_id_after = id(render_mod._REQ_ID_RE)
assert pattern_id_before == pattern_id_after, 'Regex pattern object must not be recreated per call'
# Go: verify via source that var block is at package level (static analysis / code review assertion)
